agentAction: Re-run `alln docs <command>` and fix arguments.
explain: The command was called with invalid or conflicting arguments. Consult the generated docs for the command and correct the invocation.

agentAction: Run `alln dev export-contracts`, then rebuild.
explain: Generated artifacts no longer match the registry. Regenerate and rebuild before relying on output.

agentAction: Use one of flagship | balanced | fast.
explain: The tier name was not one of flagship, balanced, or fast.

agentAction: Run `alln models --json` and pass a known model id.
explain: The model id is not in the catalog, so it cannot be assigned to a tier. List models and use a real id.

agentAction: Run `alln stalled list --all --json` and use a current episode id.
explain: No stall episode matches the given id (it may have cleared). List stalled work and retry with a live episode id.

agentAction: Run `alln doctor --json`.
explain: A required doctor check failed. Inspect the structured report and address the named check, then retry.

agentAction: Run `alln doctor --json`; add/configure the missing source.
explain: A required source CLI/runtime was not resolved on this machine. Install or locate it, then re-probe.

agentAction: Re-authenticate the named source.
explain: The source resolved but its authentication is invalid or expired. Sign in via the source's own login flow.

agentAction: Open the provider app once, run its login command in Terminal, then `alln doctor --full --agent <source>`.
explain: The source CLI could not read credentials from the macOS Keychain (SecItemCopyMatching failed). Common when Allnighter or the CLI is launched outside Terminal. Open the provider app, complete sign-in, then re-probe.

agentAction: Run `alln models --json`; pick an on-Bench ready model or enable one.
explain: The requested model is not runnable: it may be off-Bench, its source may not be ready, or it may not exist. Use `alln models --json` to see available vs on-Bench vs ready state.

agentAction: Run `alln team show --json`; fix unavailable workers.
explain: The default team has no runnable workers. Inspect and repair the team lineup before running.

agentAction: Inspect `workerId` and source error; failed worker remains visible.
explain: One worker failed. The failure is shown, never hidden; other workers may still have answered. Retry the worker or proceed with partial results.

agentAction: Retry with a ready plan writer or export worker answers.
explain: The plan-writer stage failed. Retry with a ready plan writer, or export the worker answers and synthesize later.

agentAction: Retry with lower effort or fewer workers.
explain: The team run exceeded its time budget. Reduce effort or the worker count and retry.

agentAction: Inspect failed workers and stages; retry or adjust the team.
explain: The team run ended without a usable result (e.g. failed or cancelled). Inspect the failed workers/stages in the run, then retry or change the team.

agentAction: Do not recursively spawn teams without explicit depth budget.
explain: A worker tried to start another team run beyond the allowed depth. Set an explicit depth budget if nesting is intended.

agentAction: Wait or retry after current team run completes.
explain: The concurrency governor is at capacity. Wait for a slot and retry; this is a real busy state, not a fake queue.

agentAction: Run `alln doctor --json`; ensure Allnighter's support directory is writable, or set a writable support root for MCP/eval runs.
explain: The team-run governor could not create, open, or lock its slot store. This is a storage/permission/configuration problem, not a capacity limit.

agentAction: Keep item Draft/Pending; mutating pending runs are outside Pending M1.
explain: Mutating pending runs are not enabled in this milestone. Keep the item Draft/Pending.

agentAction: Keep order unchanged; reorder only Pending items in the same serialized group.
explain: The requested Pending reorder was rejected because the item and anchor do not share the same serialized group.

agentAction: Generate a new key or reuse the original payload.
explain: The same idempotency key was reused with a different canonical payload. Use a new key or repeat the original request.

agentAction: Poll team status using nextPollAfterMs, then call team result again.
explain: The run is not terminal yet. Poll team status and retry team result when resultAvailable is true.

agentAction: Run `alln history --json`.
explain: No run matches the given id. List history and pick a valid run id or `latest`.

agentAction: Use foreground CLI or start resident mode when available.
explain: The resident coordinator is not running. Use a foreground command, or start resident mode when it is available.

agentAction: Run `alln skills --lane <lane> --json` and pick a valid skill id.
explain: No skill matches the given id. List skills for the lane and retry with a valid SkillID.

agentAction: Run `alln teams --lane <lane> --json` and pick a valid team id.
explain: No team matches the given id. List teams for the lane and retry with a valid TeamID.

agentAction: Edit the team with `teams edit` instead; only delete an edited built-in (which restores the shipped version).
explain: A built-in team that was never edited has nothing to delete. Edit it in place with `teams edit`, or use `teams restore` to revert prior edits.

agentAction: Only built-in teams can be restored; for a custom team, edit or delete it instead.
explain: Restore reverts a built-in team to its shipped version. A custom team has no shipped version to restore to.

agentAction: Duplicate the built-in skill, then edit the custom copy.
explain: Built-in skills cannot be edited or deleted. Duplicate to a custom skill and edit that copy.

agentAction: Pick a different team id or delete the conflicting custom team.
explain: A team with this id already exists.

agentAction: Pick a different skill id or delete the conflicting custom skill.
explain: A skill with this id already exists.

agentAction: Fix the team definition and retry `alln teams edit`.
explain: The team definition is invalid (missing rows, unknown skills, or bad effort/output kind).

agentAction: Fix the skill definition and retry `alln skills edit`.
explain: The skill definition is invalid (empty template, missing lane, or unknown purpose).

agentAction: Set another default team before deleting or changing the lane default.
explain: The default-team change would leave a lane without a valid default.

agentAction: Remove the skill from team definitions before deleting.
explain: The skill is still referenced by one or more team definitions.

agentAction: Pick a skill from the same lane as the team.
explain: A team row references a skill from another lane.

agentAction: Use a canonical lowercase id matching the catalog rules.
explain: The catalog id fails canonical ID rules.

agentAction: Treat as implementation bug; run export-contracts check.
explain: Output failed to match its declared schema. This is an implementation bug; run the export-contracts drift check.

agentAction: Ask the user for the named permission.
explain: The action needs a user-granted permission that is not present. Request the named permission before retrying.

agentAction: Approve or configure the MCP client before retrying.
explain: The calling MCP client is not approved. Approve or configure it, then retry.

agentAction: Re-ingest or re-send the attachment; do not retry with stale bytes.
explain: Attachment storedSha256 does not match on-disk bytes.

agentAction: Use thread_get to list resolved attachments for the turn.
explain: No attachment record exists for the requested id.

agentAction: Remove attachments until within the count cap.
explain: Too many images attached for one send.

agentAction: Use a smaller image or fewer attachments.
explain: An attachment exceeds byte or megapixel limits.

agentAction: Send PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP only.
explain: Attachment MIME type is not allowed.

agentAction: Fix or replace the corrupt image file.
explain: Image could not be decoded.

agentAction: Fix the base64 payload.
explain: MCP base64 image payload is invalid.

agentAction: Check workingDir permissions and disk space.
explain: Could not copy attachment into workspace mirror.

agentAction: Add `.allnighter/` to gitignore or info/exclude manually.
explain: Staged mirror but could not update git ignore rules.

agentAction: Reduce message or attachment count; never silently trim current send.
explain: Protected attachment block does not fit context cap.

agentAction: Bind the thread to a project/working directory, then retry.
explain: File references resolve against the Mac project root. The thread has no usable root.

agentAction: Pick a path inside the project root.
explain: The requested path escapes the enrolled project root, so Allnighter refused to read it.

agentAction: Refresh the file picker or choose an existing project file.
explain: The referenced file no longer exists at run time.

agentAction: Check file permissions or choose another file.
explain: The file exists but Allnighter could not read it as a regular file.

agentAction: Reference text files only in v1.
explain: File references v1 injects UTF-8 text. Binary files are not delivered.

agentAction: Reference a smaller file or a line range.
explain: The source file exceeds the v1 per-file read cap.

agentAction: Remove file references until within the cap.
explain: The send has more file references than v1 allows.

agentAction: Do not attach secrets; summarize the needed config manually.
explain: The path looks like credentials, keys, or an environment file and was blocked.

agentAction: Choose a valid 1-based line range inside the file.
explain: The requested line range is empty, reversed, or past the end of the file.

agentAction: Refresh the reference and re-approve the changed file before running.
explain: A delayed or pending send would read different bytes than the approved reference hash.

agentAction: Refresh the Project file picker and retry.
explain: The search catalog was stale. The resolver remains authoritative and did not deliver stale content.

agentAction: Choose a worker that can receive referenced file text or use a chat worker.
explain: The selected route cannot accept Project file references.

agentAction: Use a new idempotency key or repeat the original payload.
explain: Same idempotency key reused with a different thread send payload.

agentAction: Run `alln history --json` (or create a thread); retry with a valid thread id.
explain: No thread matches the given id, or no threads exist yet. List threads and retry with a valid thread id.

agentAction: Re-run the Bug Hunt diagnosis; the fix attempt needs a typed fix packet.
explain: The Bug Hunt answer run produced no typed fix packet (the writer emitted no fenced fix-packet block), so there is no hypothesis to try. Re-run the diagnosis with a sharper report.

agentAction: Read the gate reason; resolve the danger flag / add an actionable hypothesis + proof, then retry.
explain: The fix packet is not safe to execute: it carries a danger flag (credentials, deletion, deploy…), lacks an actionable hypothesis (a fix within a boundary), names no truth owner, or its proof method is incomplete. Danger blocks; doubt does not.

agentAction: Pass --executor a single mutating team that is runnable on this bench (default execution_playbook).
explain: The chosen fix executor is not a single, mutating, runnable team. The fix attempt must resolve to exactly one mutating worker.

agentAction: Inspect the error detail; retry the send or fix the worker.
explain: The thread send did not complete (worker or transport failure). Inspect the detail, then retry.

agentAction: Run `alln models --json` and retry with a valid model id.
explain: No model matches the given id. List models and retry with a valid ModelID.

agentAction: Duplicate the built-in model, then edit the custom copy.
explain: Built-in models cannot be edited or deleted. Duplicate to a custom model and edit that copy.

agentAction: Pick a different model id or delete the conflicting custom model.
explain: A model with this id already exists.

agentAction: Fix the model definition and retry the edit.
explain: The model definition or id is invalid (bad id, missing fields, or unknown driver mapping).

agentAction: Reference a known driver id, or add the driver manifest first.
explain: The model references a driver that is not registered. Use a known driver id or add its manifest.

agentAction: Capture the message and `traceId`; retry once, then report if it persists.
explain: An unexpected internal failure occurred (not a usage error). The detail is in the message; this is a defensive catch-all, not a routine condition.

agentAction: Run `alln project list --json`; retry with a valid id or name.
explain: No project matches the given id or name. List projects and retry with a valid identifier.

agentAction: Select or add a project, then re-run the mutating action.
explain: A mutating action was attempted with no project selected. Mutating work is always scoped to one project root.

agentAction: Use the existing project that owns this normalized root.
explain: The path resolves to an existing project's normalized root; the existing project is returned rather than a duplicate.

agentAction: Restore the folder/permissions, then `alln project show <id>` to re-observe.
explain: The project root is missing or permission-denied (rootState != available); mutating runs are blocked until the root is restored.

agentAction: Run `alln project unarchive <id>` before new runs.
explain: The project is archived. Unarchive it before starting new runs; reads remain available.

agentAction: Assign the thread/pending item to a project, then retry.
explain: The thread or pending item has no project. Assign it to a project before a mutating run.

agentAction: Run `alln project workers <id> --json`; open the CLI in the project folder and complete its trust/login, then recheck.
explain: The target worker's project readiness is not `ready` for this root. The run waits until the worker is ready here.

agentAction: The active mutating run on this repo root looks stuck (the wait bound elapsed); wait for it to finish or stop it, then retry.
explain: At most one mutating run per canonical repo root. A second mutating run normally QUEUES (FIFO) behind the active one and runs when it finishes; this error is the safety valve — it fires only when the active run is still holding the lock after the wait bound (it is wedged), so the queued run is refused instead of hanging forever.

agentAction: Restore the project folder or pick an available project root, then retry.
explain: The project repo root is missing or unreadable; runs require a real cwd in the repo.

agentAction: Pick a ready worker or run setup health, then retry.
explain: No runnable worker resolved for this run (missing CLI, wrong driver, or bench not ready).

agentAction: Pick one execution source, run as non-mutating review/propose, or split into judgment then execution.
explain: Mutating execution teams must resolve to one CLI driver. Mixed-source execution is blocked before spawn.

agentAction: Run `alln models --json`; use a known driver id in appliesTo.
explain: The utilization source id is not registered on this bench.

agentAction: Add the source to Boost window appliesTo, then retry.
explain: The source is not included in the Boost window appliesTo list.

agentAction: Sign in to the named CLI, then retry the seed.
explain: The seed stopped on an auth prompt. Allnighter never auto-confirms sign-in.

agentAction: Resolve billing on the provider, then retry.
explain: The seed stopped on a billing or quota prompt. Allnighter never auto-confirms payment.
